questions.question: For which discovery was the 2025 Nobel Prize in Physics awarded?

options.text: Observation of quantum tunneling in superconducting circuits and HVAC systems
Experimental verification of quantum coherence in large-scale systems
Demonstration of quantum state transitions in Josephson junction arrays
Discovery of macroscopic quantum mechanical tunneling and energy quantization in electric circuits

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Discovery of macroscopic quantum mechanical tunneling and energy quantization in electric circuits.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

 
• **The 2025 Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded to John Clarke, Michel H. Devoret, and John M. Martinis for their discovery of macroscopic quantum mechanical tunneling and energy quantization in electric circuits.**
 
• The laureates proved that quantum phenomena could exist at a macroscopic scale using superconducting circuits with Josephson junctions.
 
• Their experiments showed that these circuits absorb and emit energy in discrete amounts, validating the principle of energy quantization.
 
• The discovery established that large-scale electrical systems can behave as unified quantum objects.
 
• This foundational work became a cornerstone for modern quantum technologies such as quantum computers, quantum cryptography, and quantum sensors.

questions.question: Which state has emerged as the leader in UPI transaction intensity among Indian states, according to a study published by the Reserve Bank of India as per September bulletin?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Telangana.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Telangana has emerged as the leader in UPI transaction intensity among Indian states, as per a study published in the Reserve Bank of India’s September 2025 bulletin.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Along with Telangana, states like **Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Delhi** also reported high per capita UPI usage.
 
• The increase in UPI usage is attributed to factors like urban centers, employment-driven migration, and widespread smartphone and internet penetration.
 
• The study shows a growing dominance of **peer-to-merchant (P2M)** transactions, particularly for daily low-value payments.
 
• There has been a steady decline in cash demand, with UPI transactions now covering a significant portion of daily purchases under ₹500.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **UPI (Unified Payments Interface)**__: A digital payment platform enabling real-time, low-cost transactions across a range of services, especially for daily and small-value purchases.
 
• __**Peer-to-Merchant (P2M) Transactions**__: A major trend showing the growing adoption of UPI for business transactions, helping small vendors and businesses tap into digital payments.
 
• __**Declining Ticket Size**__: The average value of UPI transactions is reducing, reflecting its use for frequent, low-value payments across sectors.
 
• __**PhonePe**__: The main data source used in the study, with PhonePe accounting for 58% of UPI transaction volume and 53% of UPI transaction value.

questions.question: What is the name of the scheme inaugurated by Civil Aviation Minister Rammohan Naidu Kinjarapu to provide fixed, predictable airfares?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Fare Se Fursat.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Civil Aviation Minister Rammohan Naidu Kinjarapu inaugurated the **Fare Se Fursat** scheme, which aims to provide passengers with fixed, predictable airfares.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Under the scheme, Alliance Air will offer a **single, fixed fare** that remains constant, even on the day of departure.
 
• The scheme will be implemented on a **pilot basis until the end of the year**, covering select routes to assess feasibility and passenger response.
 
• The scheme aligns with the core principles of the **UDAN scheme**, aimed at democratizing aviation and making it affordable.
 
• The static fare system eliminates the stress of fluctuating airfares and ensures **predictability** of costs for passengers, even for last-minute bookings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **UDAN scheme**__: A government initiative aimed at making air travel affordable and accessible, especially for underserved regions of India.
 
• __**Alliance Air**__: A government-owned regional carrier, responsible for operating flights under the UDAN scheme and now implementing the Fare Se Fursat initiative.
 
• __**Fixed fare system**__: A pricing system that offers a constant fare regardless of when the ticket is purchased, eliminating price fluctuations based on booking dates.
 
• __**Last-minute bookings**__: A feature of the scheme that allows passengers to book flights without worrying about rising costs, even close to the departure date.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the chairperson of the newly constituted Payments Regulatory Board (PRB) by the Reserve Bank of India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sanjay Malhotra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has constituted the Payments Regulatory Board (PRB)__ to oversee the country's payment systems, chaired by RBI Governor __Sanjay Malhotra__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The PRB replaces the Board for Regulation and Supervision of Payment and Settlement Systems (BPSS), a committee of the RBI’s Central Board.**
 
• **It will be supported by the Department of Payment and Settlement Systems (DPSS)__, which reports directly to the PRB.**
 
• **The Board comprises __RBI officials__ (Deputy Governor, Executive Director for Payment Systems) and __Central Government nominees__ including Aruna Sundararajan.**
 
• **The board's decisions will be made by majority vote, with the __chairperson holding a casting vote__ in case of a tie.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Payments Regulatory Board (PRB)**__

 __
 
• Established to regulate and supervise payment systems in India, both electronic and non-electronic.
 
• Authority derives from the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007__.
 
• The board is responsible for overseeing __domestic and cross-border payment systems__.
 
 
 
• __**RBI's Role in Payment Systems**__
 __
 
• The RBI has been central to India’s payment and settlement systems, ensuring safety and efficiency.
 
 
 
• **Aruna Sundararajan**__
 __
 
• Former Telecom Secretary, now a nominee to the PRB representing the central government.
 
 
 
• **Voting and Decision-Making**__
 
 
• The PRB makes decisions by majority vote, and the chairperson has a casting vote in case of a tie.
 
• The board must meet at least twice annually, and decisions can also be made via circulation if directed by the chairperson.

questions.question: What does IRSA stand for, as announced by DRDO and the Integrated Defence Staff?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Radio Software Architecture.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) launched the Indian Radio Software Architecture (IRSA) version 1.0, marking a significant leap in India’s military communication capabilities.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **IRSA 1.0 is India's first standardized software architecture for Software Defined Radios (SDRs), aimed at providing interoperable and future-ready communication systems for India’s military.**
 
• **The architecture defines unified APIs, interfaces, and execution environments to ensure waveform portability, certification, and interoperability across all defence services.**
 
• **IRSA adopts NATO’s Software Communications Architecture (SCA) 4.1, tailored to meet India’s operational needs.**
 
• **IRSA was approved by the High-Level Advisory Committee (HLAC) in 2025, and the work on its development began in 2022.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Software Defined Radios (SDRs)__

 __
 
• A type of radio communication system where most of the components traditionally done in hardware are now handled through software, offering more flexibility and adaptability.
 
 
 
• Software Communications Architecture (SCA)__
 __
 
• A NATO standard defining the architecture for SDRs, ensuring flexibility, interoperability, and portability across various platforms.
 
 
 
• Tri-Services__
 
 
• The combined armed forces of India — Army, Navy, and Air Force — that work together on joint operations and initiatives.

questions.question: Which country was awarded the prestigious International Social Security Association (ISSA) Award for Outstanding Achievement in Social Security 2025?

questions.question: What is the main characteristic of the asteroid 2025 PN7 that makes it unique?

options.text: It orbits Earth like the Moon
It travels around the Sun in an orbit nearly identical to Earth’s
It is gravitationally bound to Earth
It is classified as a planet

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**It travels around the Sun in an orbit nearly identical to Earth’s.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **2025 PN7 is a small asteroid that travels around the Sun in almost the same orbit as Earth.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• It was discovered by astronomers at the University of Hawaii and confirmed by NASA.
 
• Although it is not a real moon, its path makes it appear to follow Earth through space.
 
• It has been moving near Earth’s orbit for almost 60 years and may continue doing so until around 2083.
 
• **The asteroid 2025 PN7 is classified as a "quasi-moon" due to its orbit around the Sun that closely mirrors Earth’s orbit.**
 
• **At its closest point, 2025 PN7 is about 4 million kilometres from Earth, much farther than the Moon.**
 
• **This asteroid is not gravitationally bound to Earth and will eventually drift away into deep space.**
 
• **NASA scientists study quasi-moons like 2025 PN7 to understand asteroid movements and orbital mechanics within the solar system.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Quasi-Moon__

 __
 
• A small celestial body that follows a path similar to Earth's orbit but is not gravitationally bound to Earth.
 
 
 
• NASA__
 __
 
• NASA is the United States government agency responsible for the civilian space program and aeronautics research.
 
 
 
• Orbit__
 __
 
• The curved path of a celestial object around a star, planet, or moon, due to the gravitational attraction between them.
 
 
 
• Asteroid__
 
 
• A small rocky body orbiting the Sun, typically found in the asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter.
